findings.evidence: Features are grouped by rule. When the jev-fast-decision skill is installed, the grouping choice can be proposed through its entry point. A needs_fallback answer or no answer means the rule-based grouping decides. Nothing needs configuring.
findings.fix: Keep the fallback rule in SKILL.md and move the jev entry-point detail into references/folding-policy.md, loaded only when jev-fast-decision is installed; record that move.

findings.evidence: The NEVER list has no Gotchas heading for environment facts such as a bare relative capability path being read as a registry name, and a step command not being a PATH program.
findings.fix: Add a short Gotchas section that restates those two already-documented traps with their reasons, without dropping the NEVER list.

findings.evidence: The description names fold, status, unit flow, boundary, checkpoint, ready, restack, hotfix and merge-chain, but not the status form or the boundary command a user can ask for without saying fold.
findings.fix: Folds a finished GSD or superpowers plan's commits into one commit per logical feature (backup tag, tree-equality check), reports which plans are still unfolded with fold.py status, and runs ai-kit's unit flow for stacked phase branches: start a unit branch, run fold.py boundary (codebase-memory-mcp and graphify refresh, unit brief), fold and push checkpoints under push consent, mark the draft PR ready, restack, start a hotfix unit, run the owner's merge chain, install the GSD hooks. Use when a plan's task commits should be regrouped into feature commits, when asked which plans are unfolded or for fold status, before plan-phase or execute-phase of a GSD phase in a unit-flow repo, or when a GSD phase or superpowers plan there needs its branch started, briefed, pushed, readied, restacked or merged, even without the word fold. Not for squashing a branch, interactive rebases, a plain git push or gh pr create outside a recorded unit, a bare codebase-memory-mcp or graphify run, or an ordinary hotfix commit.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md loads adapter-guide.md only when wiring a planning system other than GSD or superpowers, but the file's GSD and superpowers hook order is also the procedure those runs need.
findings.fix: Change the SKILL.md load line to: read references/adapter-guide.md when wiring another planning system, or when a GSD or superpowers run needs its hook point or command order; do not load it for a plain fold.

findings.evidence: 13 should-trigger and 11 should-not-trigger queries, above the 8-10 band, and the negatives omit near-misses for a bare graphify refresh, an ordinary hotfix commit, and a push or PR outside a recorded unit.
findings.fix: Cut the set to about 20 and replace the easy negatives (conventional commit, revert, cherry-pick, GSD model profile) with near-misses: a bare graphify refresh, an ordinary hotfix commit, and a git push or gh pr create that is not part of a recorded unit.

findings.evidence: The module docstring documents the forms and exit codes, and argparse supplies --help, but the unit-flow subcommands are only named, not given usage examples.
findings.fix: Add three examples to the fold.py docstring: fold.py checkpoint --phase 7 --final, fold.py restack --continue --note path=how, and fold.py show --all.

findings.evidence: start sets worktree.baseRef to head. The GSD start path in gsd/ai-kit-commit-fold/ai-kit-fold.cjs calls gsd-tools worktree set-baseref, whose no-clobber write leaves an existing non-head baseRef unchanged.
findings.fix: Replace that sentence with: when workflow.use_worktrees is true, the GSD start command runs gsd-tools worktree set-baseref, which writes worktree.baseRef head only when that key is absent; an existing different value is left as-is.

findings.evidence: The first line is flow <command> <unit>: <branch>. The last line is outcome:. Between them at most six lines, plus one skipped: line per skipped push. SKILL.md's Read the report section instead fixes the fold report at five lines, so a flow report with skipped pushes and notes exceeds what an agent using only SKILL.md expects.
findings.fix: In SKILL.md under Unit flow, state that a flow report is not the five-line fold report: first line flow <command> <unit>: <branch>, last line outcome:, and extra skipped: and note: lines are part of the report to relay.
